title: Fund opening and lifecycle requests (workspace frame)
statement: WS-06 MUST be the applicant's and donor's single place to start and follow requests that change a fund's existence: opening a fund, closing it and transferring its balance to another sponsor. Layout: scope-trail (sponsor > program > fund, G-010) above a navigation-shell with three views: 'Open a fund', 'Close a fund', 'Transfer to another sponsor'. The landing view MUST list the user's open requests first (RCD-026), ordered by what needs the user: (1) items waiting on the user with a due date, e.g. 'Choose where the balance goes' with the residual-recommendation window end date, an application draft with its agreement version, an expired-agreement re-acknowledgment; (2) requests in progress with their current status label and the party acting next; then (3) start actions. 'Close a fund' MUST be offered only to an advisory-privilege holder of an Open fund; 'Transfer to another sponsor' MUST be reachable only from a closure in 'Choose where the balance goes' (RCD-040: outbound transfer is the residual payout inside closure). For other participants these entries are shown unavailable with the reason (FORMA-GAP-11). The frame MUST carry the legal-sponsor disclosure footer (G-014) and render protected legal text verbatim (G-007). There is no period context; dates are absolute in the sponsor's time zone (G-018).

title: Recurring schedule management
statement: Within WS-02, the 'Recurring schedules' view MUST list the user's schedules for the fund in a master-detail layout. List rows: charity (canonical name and EIN), amount (G-017; percentage schedules show percentage and base), cadence, next occurrence date (G-018), schedule version, date of the standing affirmation, and status. Detail: schedule facts; the occurrence history as a timeline with each created grant linked to grant detail (S-004); the adverse-occurrence counter against the suspension threshold, where a held occurrence counts and is skipped (RCD-043). Actions by state: Active -> Amend, Cancel; 'Suspended – needs your confirmation' -> Resume (requires an unticked explicit reconfirmation and the advisory-only statement verbatim, G-007), Cancel; 'This month's grant on hold' -> Cancel (the held occurrence is skipped by the system; there is no 'skip' or 'release hold' control); 'Suspended – authority review' -> Resume only for a successor with activated rights, read-only for others with the reason. Amending amount, recipient or purpose MUST show that a new schedule version and a new standing affirmation are created and take effect from the next occurrence. Cancel MUST state that grants already created continue and can be cancelled only by request from grant detail.

title: Assisted change console
statement: The 'Assisted change' view MUST let a support agent stage, never apply, a change for an authenticated caller. Steps: record caller authentication with the assurance level achieved against the level the change requires (insufficient assurance blocks the change), the channel and the staff identity; choose the change type and enter the new values; review a before/after diff; send the confirmation to a verified channel on file (the agent chooses among verified channels only, never a channel supplied on the call). The case then shows 'Awaiting your confirmation' with expiry. For a charity payment destination change, the agent records a staff-assisted change that creates a new destination version 'Change requested', which must be confirmed via the charity's verified channel and independently verified before use; the previous channel is notified. Not available: apply change, mark confirmed, or verify a destination.

acceptance_criteria.given: a caller authenticated at a lower assurance than the change requires
acceptance_criteria.when: the agent tries to stage it
acceptance_criteria.then: staging is refused with 'Caller assurance too low for this change'

acceptance_criteria.given: a staged change
acceptance_criteria.when: the agent looks for an apply action
acceptance_criteria.then: none exists; the case shows 'Awaiting your confirmation'

acceptance_criteria.given: a caller asks to send confirmation to a new email
acceptance_criteria.when: the agent opens the channel list
acceptance_criteria.then: only verified channels on file are offered
